title: docs(adr-0053): D-F1 says `findWithWindowFunctions` applies no read presentation — false once #16716 merges (governed, docs-only)
body:
Filed by the director seat from the contract review of PR #16716 (5578892124, F4). Governed path (`docs/adr/**`) — a dedicated docs-only PR, merged by the maintainer; ⛔ not a rider on #16716.

## What goes stale

`docs/adr/0053-date-and-datetime-semantics.md` on `main`:
- `:1080-1081` — "`findWithWindowFunctions` is not one of these doors"
- `:1157-1159` — "Not covered: `findWithWindowFunctions`, which applies no read presentation of any kind today"

PR #16716 (card #16609) routes `findWithWindowFunctions` rows through the shared `formatOutput` presenter — the same call `findRows()` makes — so after merge the door presents booleans, JSON, numeric strings, audit / `Field.datetime` instants (canonical `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ` on every dialect post-#16619), `Field.date`, `Field.time`, and `external.columnMap` key renames. The ADR would then declare narrower than enforced — the inverse of the D-F addendum's stated purpose.

## Deliverable

One-line amendment at each of the two sites: `findWithWindowFunctions` is a covered door as of #16716, with alias columns carved out (the alias wins the key, its value stays raw). No other ADR text moves. Re-derive line numbers by symbol at PR time. The non-governed test-header comment in `sql-driver-13973-canonical-iso-read-door.test.ts` (`:20-22`) is corrected inside #16716 itself.

Sequencing: open after #16716 is merged (or reference its merge commit), so the ADR never describes a door that has not landed.
